programme.title: Undergraduate Major in Computer Science
programme.degree: Bachelor of Science, computer science option (Computing + Mathematical Sciences department); 4 years; fall entry
programme.how_found: caltech.edu -> Computing + Mathematical Sciences (cms.caltech.edu) -> Academics -> Undergraduate Programs -> 'Undergraduate Major in Computer Science' (the short link /academics/ugrad_cs serves the same page); the department page links the Academic Catalog entry 'Computer Science Option and Minor (CS)'.
programme.notes: English-only site, no language twins. Admission is to Caltech as a whole (no admission by major); the CS-specific page has no admissions content, so english, deadline, tuition and aid come from the university-wide undergraduate admissions and financial aid pages (owner ruling for US universities). Language of instruction is not stated on the programme page (English, US institution).

english.quote: Test Minimum Total Minimum in each area IELTS 7 7 TOEFL (taken before Jan. 21, 2026) 100 25 TOEFL (taken on or after Jan. 21, 2026) 5 5 Duolingo English Test 130 130
english.notes: University-wide. Required of all international applicants unless the native language is English or English is the primary language of instruction of the secondary school. TOEFL taken before 21 Jan 2026: 100 total, 25 per section; TOEFL on/after 21 Jan 2026 (new 1-6 scale): 5 total and 5 per section; DET 130 (the table lists 130 also as 'minimum in each area'). Test must be taken before the application deadline.

gpa.notes: No GPA minimum published. Prose only: 'Caltech admissions officers are trained to understand your education system, so there is no need to translate or convert grades to the American system' (international applicants page). Required coursework: four years of math incl. calculus, one year each of physics and chemistry; SAT or ACT required (no minimum published).

deadline.notes: International first-year applicants, fall 2027 entry, Regular Decision. Restrictive Early Action deadline November 1, 2026 (same table). No timezone printed. Need-aware for internationals: aid must be requested at the time of application.

tuition.notes: On-Campus Cost of Attendance, 'estimated nine-month, full-time cost of attendance budgets ... Enrolled full-time in the 2026-27 school year'. Fees 2,655; housing 12,711; food 9,285; total direct costs $93,225. 2027/28 not yet published.

scholarship_exists.quote: Caltech Scholarships are gifts awarded from institutional or endowed funds to help cover the cost of attending Caltech
scholarship_exists.notes: Need-based only; 'Caltech does not award merit scholarships' (admissions.caltech.edu/afford). Amount depends on demonstrated need; renewable yearly.

scholarship_international.quote: we offer need-based financial aid that meets 100% of your demonstrated financial need
scholarship_international.notes: International first-year applicants are eligible for need-based aid, but admission is need-aware for internationals ('the total amount of financial aid funds for international students is limited') and aid must be requested with the admission application; no aid for international transfer applicants. Competitive admission; aid sized by a need assessment.
